items.name: dbaasp_api_helper_libraries
items.description: Database of Antimicrobial Activity and Structure of Peptides (DBAASP)  is the manually-curated database. It has been developed to provide the information and analytical resources to the  scientific community in order to develop antimicrobial compounds with the high therapeutic index.

items.name: dbaasp-crawler
items.description: fetching and arranging peptide samples from DBAASP database

items.name: dbaasp
items.description: Scrapes antimicrobial peptide data from DBAASP v4 and outputs an Excel report + HTML page.

items.name: Generative-Design-for-drug-Discovery
items.description: Gen-3D is a Generative Data Benchmark design for Drug Discovery. This is code use  a subset of data from DBAASP suited for active learning for generating peptides and scVelo - RNA velocity generalized through dynamical modeling.

items.name: LSTM-biLSTM-based-peptide-inhibitors
items.description: In this work, we are employing LSTM/biLSTM deep learning method to generate potential peptides for targeting sandfly-borne Leishmania and CHPV. In this study, a positive dataset was developed by considering APD3, DRAVP, CAMP, dbAMP, DBAASPS databases, and negative datasets were extracted from HORDB and UniProt.
